entries.084de8296d4ec3b4: It imports active pharmaceutical ingredients, which are pharmaceutical raw materials, and supplies them mainly to generic drug manufacturers. Its main focus is to supply high-quality, low-cost active pharmaceutical ingredients on a stable basis.
entries.2a8144ba187142c0: This business is carried out by consolidated subsidiary KOA SHOJI Co., Ltd., which imports pharmaceutical raw materials, active pharmaceutical ingredients, from overseas and sells them to pharmaceutical companies, mainly generic drug manufacturers. It has in-house analytical capabilities and also provides quality confirmation and proposals and support for new development items. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥15,717 million, making it the Group's largest business.
entries.4294b6d03e8eeeec: Pharmaceutical companies, mainly generic drug manufacturers
entries.4c1875448940b1a9: The holding company of a group that imports and sells active pharmaceutical ingredients used as raw materials for generic drugs, and manufactures and sells pharmaceuticals centered on injectables.
entries.57691357ffc41407: Manufacture and sale, and purchase and sale, of pharmaceuticals
entries.637b774464fab77e: Pharmaceutical companies such as major domestic manufacturers
entries.63eb0f8bdc4de769: It undertakes manufacturing of pharmaceutical preparations on commission from major domestic manufacturers and others. It also provides contract manufacturing utilizing its production facilities for highly pharmacologically active injectables.
entries.d92d8fa16a7678ad: In addition to conducting quality analysis of imported active pharmaceutical ingredients at its Pharmaceutical Analysis Center, it provides proposals and support from customers' research and development stages, and proposes quality improvements and provides technology for new manufacturing methods to active pharmaceutical ingredient manufacturers.
entries.ea9e1a78f5e73c38: This business is carried out by consolidated subsidiaries Koaisei Co., Ltd. and Koa Biotech Bay Co., Ltd., which manufacture and sell, and purchase and sell, prescription and over-the-counter pharmaceuticals, and also perform contract manufacturing of pharmaceutical preparations. It owns production facilities for highly pharmacologically active injectables, which require advanced technology and investment. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥8,961 million.
entries.f1cd04fd46e9169f: Import and sales of active pharmaceutical ingredients
entries.fb8ac0405e264aef: It manufactures and sells, and purchases and sells, prescription and over-the-counter pharmaceuticals, mainly generic drugs. It also actively manufactures and sells its in-house developed products.
